note: Written by Claude (Fable 5.1, an AI model) on 2026-09-21, working only from a written task description; the author saw no code, no classifier and no other fixture in this repository, so these labels are independent of any implementation. Labelling policy: an utterance gets a pose label only when it asks the robot to pose its own head, with 'look up' alone = up, 'look down at the desk/table' = desk, 'straight up / at the ceiling' = ceiling, 'look at me / face me / straight ahead / come back' = center, and a nudge or limit modifier anywhere in the utterance selecting the bit_* or far_* label. Everything else is none, including 'look up <something>' searches, looking at or finding a named object, looking around, computer actions and chit-chat that merely contain direction words, and stop/cancel words.
